title: Dataset containing resting EEG for a sample of 103 normal infants in the first year of life
description: This dataset comprises resting-state electroencephalography (EEG) recordings from 103 healthy infants during the first year of life, with a total of 130 recordings distributed across four sessions. The dataset includes both longitudinal and cross-sectional data, providing a normative reference for early brain electrical activity and neurodevelopmental trajectories in infancy. These recordings serve as a foundation for understanding typical EEG patterns during critical periods of brain synaptogenesis and myelination. This NEMAR enriched version is derived from the OpenNeuro dataset (10.18112/openneuro.ds004577.v1.0.1) and includes standardized metadata and quality assurance enhancements.
methods_description: Resting EEG recordings were collected from 103 normal infants (41 female, 62 male) in the first year of life. Data were acquired across 4 sessions with variable numbers of recordings per subject: 81 subjects with 1 recording, 18 subjects with 2 recordings, 3 subjects with 3 recordings, and 1 subject with 4 recordings, yielding 130 total EEG recordings.
